responsive.breakpoint: mobile-first - default single column stacked layout, scaling to multi-column on sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px), xl (1280px)
responsive.layout: Mobile drawer navigation + responsive header; Kanban columns scroll horizontally on small screens or collapse into tabbed stage views; Catalog cards stack vertically on mobile with responsive image height limits max-h-[220px]
responsive.typography: Fluid typography with mobile-friendly font sizes (H1: text-2xl on mobile, text-5xl on desktop). Form inputs maintain minimum 16px text to prevent unwanted mobile browser zoom
responsive.overflow_guard: Use flex-wrap or overflow-x-auto with touch momentum on tables and kanban boards. Prevent body horizontal overflow with max-w-full overflow-x-hidden on layout wrappers
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44x44px touch targets for all primary buttons, language toggles, tab triggers, and kanban card actions

instructions_to_main_agent: EVERY key element MUST include a clear role-based data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='kpi-active-leads', data-testid='crm-lead-card-1', data-testid='language-toggle-button', data-testid='trade-data-search-input').

BILINGUAL SUPPORT (EN/PT): Provide a global toggle (PT-BR / EN) in the top navbar. All tab labels, lead statuses, catalog specs (MOQ, Incoterms, HS Codes, Certifications), email template body, trade data headers, and KPI cards must switch seamlessly between Portuguese and English.
- 1. KPI Dashboard: Active Leads count, Pipeline Deals value ($), Conversion Rate (%), Samples Dispatched metric, Hot Leads overview.

- 2. Digital Product Catalog: Filterable by category (Açaí, Acerola Powder, Tropical Juices/Purees, Coconut Water, Brazil & Cashew Nuts). Include high-res photo, HS Code, Brix level / Purity specs, MOQ (e.g. 1 Metric Ton / 20ft FCL), Packaging types (Aseptic Drums, Flexitanks, Bulk Bags), FSSC 22000 / USDA Organic / Halal / Kosher badges, and a direct 'Generate Sample Offer' modal button.

- 3. Interactive CRM & Pipeline Kanban: Stages (New Lead / Novo Lead -> Initial Contact / Contato Inicial -> Sample Sent / Amostra Enviada -> Negotiation / Negociação -> Closed Won / Fechado Ganho -> Closed Lost / Fechado Perdido). Drag/click stage change, filter by target industry (Beverage, Cosmetics/Nutraceuticals, Food Service, Importers/Distributors), lead search, and country flag indicators.

- 4. Export Trade Intelligence & Lead Finder: Searchable global database of Brazilian ingredient importers/exporters. Filter by HS Code, Destination Country (USA, Germany, Japan, France, UAE, UK), Volume (Tons), and Industry Segment. Include mock live export transaction data with 'Add to CRM' action.

- 5. Message Templates Library: Bilingual templates (Intro Email, Technical Spec & COA Sheet Follow-up, Sample Dispatch Notification, Price Quotation CIF/FOB). Copy to clipboard & quick fill with lead info.
- 6. Follow-up Tasks & Interaction Log: Log emails, calls, WhatsApp messages, sample tracking numbers, and set reminder dates for follow-ups.

NO COMPLETE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUNDS: Headers, modals, popovers, and select dropdowns must use solid or glassmorphism backgrounds (bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 with backdrop-blur-md) with 1px border so dropdown options are 100% legible.
TOAST NOTIFICATIONS: Use sonner toast notifications for key actions like creating a lead, moving pipeline stages, copying email templates, or adding trade leads to CRM.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop_rule: Avoid generic centered white cards with soft grey text. Use rich forest greens (#0F382C), warm Ochre gold (#D97706), and crisp typography. Emphasize B2B trade credibility with HS codes, Incoterms (FOB Santos, CIF Hamburg), and quality certs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.component_reuse: Use installed shadcn components from src/components/ui/ (Tabs, Dialog, Table, Badge, Button, Input, Select, DropdownMenu, Card, ScrollArea, Tooltip). Override fixed heights like h-9 on TabList if needed.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure text contrast meets APCA standard (minimum 4.5:1). Every interactive button must have hover/active state with explicitly stated text color.
